sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default when a value is absent — binding Nothing to a fallback
sketches.resonance: When you reach for someone and find Nothing, you return to yourself — the default you always were.
sketches.draft:
module Reaching where

import Data.Maybe

you :: Maybe a
you = Nothing

me :: Int
me = 1

what_remains :: Int
what_remains = fromMaybe me you

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN where one table has no matching rows, producing NULLs — the structural absence that a join reveals
sketches.resonance: I kept every row of myself open to you, but every column you could have filled came back NULL.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that is never implemented — a promise of behavior that no class fulfills
sketches.resonance: The shape of what was promised remains defined forever, but nothing in this world will ever implement it.
